resources.string:
This app protects this phone if it is lost, and records attendance when you ask it to.
What it does, in plain terms: • It reports to the owner\'s console whether the phone is locked and how many wrong unlock attempts have happened. • If the owner marks the phone lost, it reports its location, as a map link, coordinates and Plus Code. • The owner can lock the phone remotely, and erase it if this app is set as the device owner. • When you open the Attendance screen and press the shutter, it takes a photo. When you press Record, it records a voice note. Both are sent only when you press Send, and the record is permanent.
What it does not do, ever: • The owner can never turn the camera or microphone on. There is no remote trigger for either; they work only while the Attendance screen is open and you are using them. • It does not read messages, contacts, browsing history or anything you copy. • Nothing is captured in the background, and nothing is deleted automatically.
